description: Schema definition for Delhi V5 Controlled Historical-Style Dataset

fields.name: case_id
fields.description: Unique historical case identifier (CMP-V5-xxxxxx)

fields.name: event_timestamp
fields.description: Timestamp of the fraudulent transaction

fields.name: reported_at
fields.description: Complaint registration cutoff timestamp

fields.name: reporting_delay_minutes
fields.description: Elapsed minutes between event and reporting

fields.name: victim_district
fields.description: Origin revenue district of victim

fields.name: victim_lat
fields.description: Latitude of victim origin (bounded Delhi region)

fields.name: victim_lon
fields.description: Longitude of victim origin (bounded Delhi region)

fields.name: fraud_type
fields.description: Categorical fraud archetype

fields.name: payment_channel
fields.description: Payment rail used (UPI, IMPS, NEFT, RTGS, etc.)

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Total disputed fraud amount in INR

fields.name: amount_bucket
fields.description: Discretized amount bracket (MICRO, LOW, MEDIUM, HIGH, CRITICAL)

fields.name: victim_bank_group
fields.description: Banking conglomerate of complainant account

fields.name: beneficiary_account_count
fields.description: Identified direct beneficiary accounts in graph

fields.name: transaction_count
fields.description: Total downstream transactions traced before cutoff

fields.name: transaction_hop_count
fields.description: Graph hop distance from victim to terminal layer

fields.name: mule_account_count
fields.description: Total intermediary mule accounts engaged

fields.name: distinct_bank_count
fields.description: Number of unique institutional banking rails touched

fields.name: terminal_mule_district
fields.description: Geographic district associated with terminal mule account

fields.name: transaction_velocity
fields.description: INR per hour transfer pace across mule graph

fields.name: transfer_burst_score
fields.description: Ratio measuring instantaneous burst intensity

fields.name: graph_depth
fields.description: Topological graph depth

fields.name: graph_branching_factor
fields.description: Average outward node branching across mule trail

fields.name: night_activity_ratio
fields.description: Proportion of transactions occurring in nocturnal hours

fields.name: weekend_flag
fields.description: Binary flag indicating complaint occurred on weekend

fields.name: pattern_type
fields.description: Synthetic generation corridor pattern (LOCAL, ADJACENT, MULE, etc.)

fields.name: syndicate_family_id
fields.description: Latent synthetic syndicate family cohort identifier

fields.name: mule_family_id
fields.description: Latent synthetic mule ring family cohort identifier

fields.name: split
fields.description: Chronological split assignment (train, validation, test)

fields.name: realized_cashout_cluster_id
fields.description: PRIMARY TARGET: True realized cash-out cluster ID (7..66)

fields.name: realized_cashout_cluster_name
fields.description: TARGET: Name of realized cash-out cluster

fields.name: realized_cashout_district
fields.description: TARGET: District of realized cash-out cluster

fields.name: realized_cashout_lat
fields.description: TARGET: Center latitude of realized cash-out cluster

fields.name: realized_cashout_lon
fields.description: TARGET: Center longitude of realized cash-out cluster

fields.name: realized_cashout_minutes
fields.description: SECONDARY TARGET: Realized elapsed minutes to cash-out

fields.name: generation_seed
fields.description: Random seed used for deterministic generation
